items.title: Extension of the trace map on differential forms to the reflexive hull

items.difficulty_reason: The lemma constructs a canonical trace map from the pushforward of the differential forms of the source to the reflexive hull of the differentials of the base for a finite purely inseparable morphism of degree p between Noetherian normal integral schemes over a base in characteristic p, recovering the generic trace map (statement lines 590-603). The proof (proof lines 604-636) reduces to points of dimension one, classifies the local extension of discrete valuation rings, and applies the local trace construction. H2: a complete reduction and case analysis.
